hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r filepath; if [ -n "$filepath" ] && [ -f "$filepath" ]; then case "$filepath" in */references/*) exit 0 ;; *.ts|*.tsx|*.mts|*.md|*.json|*.css) if command -v prettier >/dev/null 2>&1; then prettier --write "$filepath" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; case "$filepath" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.mts) if command -v eslint >/dev/null 2>&1; then eslint --fix "$filepath" 2>/dev/null || true; fi ;; esac ;; esac; fi; }
